title: A refused first plan is fixed by its refused rows; checks stop on no progress; vision calls do not reason; the host QA deadline counts routes; the ledger records real cost on a build budget
steps: S1: From the checkout (no stand, no site, no browser) run: node --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/tracy-web/test/wo-check-plateau.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/vision-door-no-reasoning.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/wo-cost-ledger-exact-build.test.mjs apps/tracy-host/test/demo-qa-deadline.test.mjs
S2: Read the summary lines `pass` and `fail`.
expect: `an EmDash-like build flat from its third check stops at its fourth` passes and `a Joomla-like build that still improves keeps checking` passes.
`photo labels on deepseek: the model is asked not to reason, and a batch of 8 has room for 8 labels` passes.
`the deadline gives the routes their own time on top of the pages` passes.
`a vision call costs its tokens, unrounded; its ceiling stays a whole cent` passes (the database tests of that file skip without TEST_DATABASE_URL).
evidence: Local round 5 / round 3 and dev Zuni (30/10/2026): builds 78-128 min, checks 51-81 min; dev vision ~36 s a call reasoning; plan.save 4-10 whole resends; look calls booked at 1 cent each.
fence: apps/tracy-web/src/opportunities-build/agent-demo.js fixPlanDraft/refusedRowsOf; client-demo.js checksPlateaued; lib/picture-vision.js postVisionDoor; packages/wo/website-opportunities/src/cost-ledger.js SPENT/budget; apps/tracy-host/src/demo-qa-deadline.js qaDeadlineMs
